# Where Ọya works now: the myths behind the markets

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Ọya** works now.

Ọya's stories are told in Ifá divination, Candomblé praise-songs, and the oral traditions of the Yoruba and their diaspora. She is change embodied, and her myths turn on thresholds — between sky and earth, market and grave, marriage and war.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ọya
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Wind, Storms, Change
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Commerce & Governance · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** Meteorology & Weather Intelligence
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 373 of 546

## The Myth at Work

**She Who Tore.** Her very name is her biography: Ọya derives from the verb yà, 'to tear, to split apart' (Abraham, Dictionary of Modern Yoruba, 1958).  The name is a title of office. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Secret of Lightning.** Ọya was wife and battlefield companion to Ṣàngó, and the traditions agree that she learned from him what no other orisha was taught — the secret of fire and lightning.  Verger (Notes sur le Culte des Orisa et Vodun, 1981) records that when Ṣàngó's fortunes collapsed and he fled his kingdom, Ọya did not flee with him meekly: she tore at the sky with her winds, and some accounts say she cast herself into the river that bears her name, the Niger (Odò Ọya), rather than outlive his disgrace. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Storms are her canonical domain; she raises the winds that churn the Niger and announce the rainy season — the weather itself is her liturgy.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Wind & Atmospheric Energy

*Wind farms, turbines, and atmospheric resource management. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Wind, storm, and radical change in one orixá — “she who tore”; the Yoruba gale the turbine economy harvests.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọya performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Disaster Resilience & Recovery

*Emergency management, recovery, and business continuity. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The storm that tears so the forest can renew itself; destruction as the precondition of regeneration is her doctrine.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Storm devotion across Yoruba and diaspora practice.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

## The Long Employment

Ọya remains one of the most honoured orixás in the African diaspora.  She strides through the literature of the Black Atlantic — from Cuban letra del año pronouncements to Brazilian samba-enredo lyrics — as the patroness of the turnaround: the queen who loses the battle and wins the war. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity’s documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in meteorology & weather intelligence, wind & atmospheric energy, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/oya/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
